description: This PHP source file defines the PrometheusServiceClient class for interacting with the Amazon Prometheus Service API. It extends the AwsClient class and declares a set of methods for managing Prometheus resources, separated into synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: PrometheusServiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Prometheus Service API, providing methods to manage alert managers, loggers, rule groups, workspaces, and more.

methods.name: createAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Creates an alert manager definition in the Prometheus Service.

methods.name: createLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a logging configuration for the Prometheus Service.

methods.name: createRuleGroupsNamespace
methods.description: Creates a namespace for rule groups.

methods.name: createScraper
methods.description: Creates a new Prometheus scraper.

methods.name: createWorkspace
methods.description: Creates a new workspace in the Prometheus Service.

methods.name: deleteAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Deletes an existing alert manager definition.

methods.name: deleteLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes a logging configuration.

methods.name: deleteRuleGroupsNamespace
methods.description: Deletes a rule groups namespace.

methods.name: deleteScraper
methods.description: Deletes a specific Prometheus scraper.

methods.name: deleteWorkspace
methods.description: Deletes a workspace.

methods.name: describeAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves details of an alert manager definition.

methods.name: describeLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves details of a logging configuration.

methods.name: describeRuleGroupsNamespace
methods.description: Describes a rule groups namespace.

methods.name: describeScraper
methods.description: Provides details about a specific scraper.

methods.name: describeWorkspace
methods.description: Provides details about a specified workspace.

methods.name: getDefaultScraperConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves default configuration for a scraper.

methods.name: listRuleGroupsNamespaces
methods.description: Lists all rule groups namespaces.

methods.name: listScrapers
methods.description: Lists all scrapers.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listWorkspaces
methods.description: Lists all workspaces.

methods.name: putAlertManagerDefinition
methods.description: Updates or creates an alert manager definition.

methods.name: putRuleGroupsNamespace
methods.description: Adds or updates a rule groups namespace.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateLoggingConfiguration
methods.description: Updates a logging configuration.

methods.name: updateScraper
methods.description: Modifies a scraper's configuration.

methods.name: updateWorkspaceAlias
methods.description: Updates the alias for a workspace.
